clue.text: US agent coming over to take drugs and render harmless

parts.note: a Fed is an American federal agent, as in the FBI

explanation.surface: An American narcotics officer crosses the line and starts taking the drugs he should be seizing.

clue.text: Row over caring disrupted meals-on-wheels service

explanation.definitionFit: Forthcoming events are those coming up in the future, the ones that lie ahead in time.

clue.text: Dance moves picked up in parts of central Asia?
